geosR

geosR is an R package with helpers for geostatistical analysis, spatial interpolation, and preliminary resource calculations. It wraps functions from gstat, sf, terra, and tmap.

The package is in development (0.0.0.9000). Check units, coordinate systems, and calculation assumptions before using outputs in a study.

Install

Install R and the system libraries required by sf and terra on your platform (GDAL, GEOS, and PROJ where applicable). Then run:

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ghoziankarami/geosR", build_vignettes = FALSE)
library(geosR)

Building vignettes is optional and also requires knitr, rmarkdown, and Pandoc. Use build_vignettes = TRUE once those tools are installed.

Functions

Functions Purpose
fit_var(), est_krige() Variogram fitting and kriging.
calc_res(), ev_rest() Resource calculations and recovery adjustments.
plot_res() Spatial maps using tmap.
nscore(), backtr(), no_outlier() Distribution transformations and outlier handling.

Consult each function’s help page for argument names and units:

help("fit_var", package = "geosR")
help("calc_res", package = "geosR")

Tutorials and function reference are published through pkgdown. The vignette source is in vignettes/.

Repository

Path Contents
R/ Package functions.
man/ Function help files generated by roxygen2.
vignettes/ Tutorial sources.
analysis/ Worked analyses and supporting manuscripts.
.github/workflows/ Documentation build and contribution checks.

For local package checks:

git clone https://github.com/ghoziankarami/geosR.git
R CMD build geosR
R CMD check --no-manual geosR_0.0.0.9000.tar.gz

This package assists calculations; its outputs are not a certified resource or reserve statement. Independent geological and statistical review is required.
